reason.fa: دوز انسولین فردی است: بر اساس نیاز متابولیک، پایش قند خون و هدف درمان. زیرجلدی حدود ۳۰ دقیقه قبل از غذا، معمولاً همراه انسولین متوسط یا طولانی‌اثر.
reason.en: Insulin dose is individualised: by metabolic needs, glucose monitoring and glycaemic goal. Subcutaneously about 30 min before meals, usually with an intermediate- or long-acting insulin.

text.en: Label states no clear risk or has limited data; use only if needed, under medical advice.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Available data from published studies over decades have not established an association with human insulin use during pregnancy and major birth defects, miscarriage, or adverse maternal or fetal outcomes (see Data ) .

text.fa: برچسب: در شیردهی با احتیاط؛ متن برچسب را ببینید.
text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary Available data from published literature suggests that exogenous human insulin products, including HUMULIN R, are transferred into human milk.

text.fa: برچسب برای کودکان شرط، محدودیت سنی یا نکته دارد؛ جمله برچسب در زیر آمده است.
text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: HUMULIN R is indicated to improve glycemic control in pediatric patients with diabetes mellitus.

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: Elderly patients using HUMULIN R may be at increased risk of hypoglycemia due to co-morbid disease [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.3 )] .
